answer: Re-attestations are stored in vault and ferrous lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the mirror graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 480 impostors cost 749 times the honest price and take 5 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
